bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; authorizing certain third-party testing by transit operators; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 171.3213.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 171.3213, is amended to read:

171.3213 THIRD-PARTY TESTING OF [-SCHOOL BUS-][+ CERTAIN+] DRIVERS.
[+(a) +]A school district that is a third-party testing program and owns or operates school buses may enter into an agreement with other school districts to test the other districts' school bus driver employees. A school bus company that is a third-party testing program and owns or operates school buses may enter into an agreement with other school bus companies to test the other companies' school bus driver employees.

[+(b) A transit operator that is a third-party testing program and owns or operates transit buses may enter into an agreement with other transit operators to test the other transit operators' transit bus driver employees. +]

[+(c)+] A third-party testing program[+ that performs testing under this section+] may be reimbursed by the tested driver's school district [-or-][+, school bus+] company[+, or transit operator+].
[-The-][+ (d) An+] agreement[+ under this section+] must be submitted to the commissioner for approval. A certified third-party tester must be employed by [-a school district or a school bus company providing-][+ the third-party testing program that provides+] the testing services.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; authorizing certain third-party testing by transit operators; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 171.3213.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 171.3213, is amended to read:

171.3213 THIRD-PARTY TESTING OF CERTAIN DRIVERS.
(a) A school district that is a third-party testing program and owns or operates school buses may enter into an agreement with other school districts to test the other districts' school bus driver employees. A school bus company that is a third-party testing program and owns or operates school buses may enter into an agreement with other school bus companies to test the other companies' school bus driver employees.

(b) A transit operator that is a third-party testing program and owns or operates transit buses may enter into an agreement with other transit operators to test the other transit operators' transit bus driver employees.

(c) A third-party testing program that performs testing under this section may be reimbursed by the tested driver's school district , school bus company, or transit operator.
(d) An agreement under this section must be submitted to the commissioner for approval. A certified third-party tester must be employed by the third-party testing program that provides the testing services.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: (b) A transit operator that is a third-party testing program and owns or operates transit buses may enter into an agreement with other transit operators to test the other transit operators' transit bus driver employees.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
